verdict.rationale: The API mirrors most consumer search surfaces: the same index that powers Brave Search, plus web, image, video, news, local/places, suggestions, spellcheck, Goggles, search operators, SafeSearch, date filters, and AI answers/summaries. No source states full API–UI parity, and dashboard functions such as key management, billing and plan changes are not shown as available through the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API access to dashboard and account functions (keys, billing, plan switching), and independent hands-on confirmation that UI-only features are absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Brave Search API gives you access to the same powerful, independent search index that powers Brave Search
